description: cfd_2d_dambreak_amr3_adapt_sub (two adaptive levels, subcycling G 7 1) with the one-step scheme and the momentum carried with the mass flux (N 40 5, N 59 1): every level takes its own step in the order of momentum_rk::step_ssp, the momentum with u(n) and phi(n) and the projection of the level first, then the level set with the projected u(n+1) (validation 80).
covers: cfd_amr::patch_step_onestep and the level-0 step of step_sub with N 40 5
